notes: v0.6v // BASALT // GHOSTLIGHT: C03 per-guest identity for share links. Every share login now mints a fresh server-side guest id stored on the session, and conversations carry the id of the visit that created them. While a share's history grant is OFF (the default), a guest's conversation list, message reads, deletes, exports, stop and stream re-attach are fenced to threads belonging to that guest's own visit; a stale conversation id silently starts a fresh thread instead of touching a stranger's. Turning history ON is explicit consent to a group room: every guest sees and can join every thread of the share, including pre-existing ones. Threads created before this release belong to no visit - visible only with history ON, never attributed by guessing. The recall tool inherits identity from the executing conversation and fails closed when there is no stamp. Evidence: new R23 battery 57 checks green, 439-point regression suite green on forge bytes, 290 points on these exact shipped bytes, JS syntax gate 14/14 by byte-identity with the previously node-checked set. Nonce 13.
